sources.title: Engineering Tools for Designers with Legends of Runeterra
sources.supported: Historical internal playtest failure: presence-based Python activation and residual scripts on reused build nodes. Authors suggest an explicit toggle as a useful safeguard.

original_analysis: Separate intended execution system, expected content identity, observed effective system and content; define residual-conflict and missing-content behavior. Compare otherwise matched clean and residual workspaces against the chosen policy.
limits: The source does not identify a toggle as the implemented incident fix or disclose its implementation.
A/B and acceptance checks are original hypothetical suggestions, not Riot fields or procedures.
An explicit setting can itself be stale or wrong and is not a compatibility, isolation or deployment-safety guarantee.
No claim about current LoR architecture.

deduplication.scope: Current complete build engineer reader, related prior local gates, full remote tree and default-branch title/author/source keyword queries. Not an exhaustive all-history semantic proof.
deduplication.distinct_value: Residual files influencing the choice of executing system, beyond generic cache invalidation and build output identity.
